mapper.select:
SELECT t.id, t.room_id AS roomId, r.room_no AS roomNo, t.title, t.content, t.remark, t.status, t.created_by AS createdBy, t.created_at AS createdAt, t.assigned_to AS assignedTo, t.assigned_at AS assignedAt, t.done_by AS doneBy, t.done_at AS doneAt FROM task t LEFT JOIN room r ON r.id = t.room_id WHERE 1=1
AND t.status = #{status}
AND (t.created_by = #{username} OR t.assigned_to = #{username})
ORDER BY t.created_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO task (room_id, title, content, remark, status, created_by, created_at) VALUES (#{roomId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{remark}, #{status}, #{createdBy}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT t.id, t.room_id AS roomId, r.room_no AS roomNo, t.title, t.content, t.remark, t.status, t.created_by AS createdBy, t.created_at AS createdAt, t.assigned_to AS assignedTo, t.assigned_at AS assignedAt, t.done_by AS doneBy, t.done_at AS doneAt FROM task t LEFT JOIN room r ON r.id = t.room_id WHERE t.id = #{id}
